opening.argument: The offer presents deposited crypto as producing recurring passive income, claiming that “cloud token is going to reward us on average 10% a month” and describing a wallet that “pays me to keep my money in there.” It further links funded recruitment to layered matching bonuses: a first-level participant’s earnings generate a “100% matching bonus,” while a later level promises a 50% match. The pitch is reinforced by an allegedly always-winning trading mechanism and steep token-price projections, including the claim that “30 cents goes to 60 cents” and the reward correspondingly doubles. Although training and uncertainty disclaimers appear elsewhere, the central presentation promotes wallet funding, recruitment, recurring rewards, and token appreciation as the basis for participation.
